label: D1 with mild a2 preference, early-mid episode (largest on first reward after a non-reward)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2) and essentially only when the agent has been choosing a2 (prev_action 2 or first trial in window; 0 activations after an a1 choice, next_action 2 in 86% of mass). Policy logit at D1 is in a narrow mildly-a2 band (-4.4 to -1.5, 98% of mass), value is mid-range (7.1-7.7), and it is restricted to episode trials ~3-50 (none after trial ~60), skewed to low_first episodes where S2 is good. Recorded predicate (D1 & choice band & ep_trial 3-39) catches about 92% of mass but precision is only about 0.21, so it is a necessary-condition description. Magnitude: biggest on the first rewarded D1 after one or more unrewarded trials, decaying over consecutive rewards (e.g. 1.00 -> 0.31 -> 0.02); adding in_rew==1 & reward two trials back != 1 raises precision to 0.38 (F1 0.43) but drops mass to 0.65. Raw magnitudes are tiny (max ~0.001), so this is a near-closed update gate opening slightly. Does not fire after a1 choices, at GO/D2, or late in episodes.
